## Summary

E215: Comtrade entrant share analysis completed. Tested fragmentation→entry hypothesis in international trade (third domain after NIH SBIR E208 and federal IT E209). Kill gate G3 FIRED: Spearman ρ = -0.123, p = 0.623 (negative correlation, opposite to hypothesis). All 12 analyzable HS codes are HS 84/85 machinery/electronics due to API rate limits; all show high concentration (top5 0.57-0.95) and low entrant fractions (0-19%). Cross-domain summary: pattern fails in all 3 tested domains (NIH SBIR ρ=-0.246, federal IT ρ=+0.667 p=0.135, Comtrade ρ=-0.123). Next: fresh observation in completely new domain axis per D083.
